tuition.assumptions: A conservative ceiling for the ordinary 30-credit on-campus PMP at the 2026-27 international tuition rate; this is not a flat full-program quote.

The official fee table maps Computer Sciences MS / Professional Program to Graduate tuition. Page 6 separates USD 1,503.40 tuition per credit from segregated fees, with an eight-credit semester plateau; page 49 confirms the program mapping.
Ignoring the tuition plateau gives an upper bound of 30 x USD 1,503.40 = USD 45,102. The exact bill can be lower and needs a term-by-term schedule.
Future increases, added courses or terms, fees, insurance and living costs are excluded. PMP has no assistantship tuition remission; no unconfirmed aid is deducted.

directory_policies.notes.9: Cost context: Tuition-only ceiling USD 45,102 at 2026-27 rates for 30 credits. Semester plateaus can reduce the bill; extra study and fees are excluded. A lower budget needs a billing schedule, not automatic rejection.
directory_policies.notes.10: Deadlines: The current exact-program PDC page confirms Fall 2027 and February 15, 2027. The older yearless department table is retained only as historical context.

fact_summary: The exact Professional Program page identifies 30 graduate credits and a dated Fall 2027 deadline. Together with the fee-table tuition column it supports a conservative pricing ceiling, not an exact bill.
